description: Render or transform an image or video with a catalog model (t2i, i2i, t2v, i2v, tool — tools like upscale/remove-background take image with no prompt; face-swap takes image + image2; motion models take image + video) — including the private model line flagged private=true in list_models. PAID. If this MCP request carries your API key (x-api-key / Authorization: Bearer lp_… — create at https://livepairai.com/settings after /auth/sign-up) the run executes right here and returns {status:'done',url} or a jobId to poll with get_job. Without a key the upstream answers 402 and this tool returns the x402 payment requirements (USDC on Base) for your wallet to settle.

extra.description: Model-specific settings keyed by the names in the model's `extraSettings` (list_models) — e.g. {quality:'720p'} for pixverse-motion, {targetGender:'female'} for face swaps

image.description: Source image — required for i2i/i2v/tool models. Public http(s) URL or data:image URI. Use AI-generated or owned images only — never real-person photos without consent

image2.description: Second image input — the face to place on face-swap models (image-face-swap, video-face-swap). Same URL/data:image rules; use only faces you have consent to use

modelId.description: Model id from list_models (default: fastest t2i)

payer.description: Your 0x… wallet — applies your volume-tier discount; must equal the wallet signing the payment (x402 rail)

prompt.description: The prompt to render — call enhance_prompt first for best results. Not needed for mode=tool models (upscale, remove-bg) — the image is the request

referenceIds.description: Pin media references from search_references (yours or pack refs, ≤4) — fills the model's open image/video inputs as style/content references

resolution.description: Video resolution tier, or upscale tier for tool models

useReferences.description: Auto-pick refs from your library by prompt semantics (owner namespace only) — prefer search_references + referenceIds so the user can approve candidates

video.description: Source clip — required for motion-control and video-face-swap models (motion reference or swap target). https URL or data:video URI, ≤40MB. Priced on the clip's measured length

name: generate_image
title: Generate an image or video (paid)
